messages.author: c7be00e18e82df36
messages.subject: tcltk package
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to implement a dialogue box to display messages in rstudio. it works well when i run it on my localhost. However, when i upload the files onto the rstudio server, i receive the message:

Error in structure(.External("dotTclObjv", objv, PACKAGE = "tcltk"), class = "tclObj") : 
  [tcl] invalid command name "tk_messageBox".

I read some posts which implies that the package does not work with rstudio. is this still the case?  if  it is still the case, are there any other available options i can implement?

Please help me out to fix this. Thanks.

Rueben

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: tcltk package
parts:
tcltk won't work with Shiny on the server, since tcltk will be trying to launch windows on the server which is almost certainly not what you want, even if it worked.

For message boxes, you could do something with custom messages, like this:

Add this to ui.R, somewhere inside your UI (doesn't matter where):
  tags$script("Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler('messageBox', function(msg){window.alert(msg);})")

Then whenever you want to send a message in server.R, use this (change "Hello!" to any string):
  session$sendCustomMessage("messageBox", "Hello!")
